caption: The drawing features a single wooden figurine of a human figure with elongated arms, standing upright on a small round pedestal. The figure has a stern facial expression, a pronounced mustache, and a hair bun or topknot. The top of the head is dark brown, the face is a lighter brown, and the torso is painted in a dark red color. The arms and lower body are shaded in dark brown and black, with the elongated arms curving slightly outward before tapering down. The figure is wearing high black boots, and the overall color palette consists mainly of browns, reds, and black. The background is plain and cream-colored, bordered by a thin rectangular line. The artist's signature, "MINA LOWRY," appears in the lower left corner outside the border.
title: Whirligig
